steps.prompt: Pieces are stronger in the centre where they control more squares. 'A knight on the rim is dim': on the edge it sees only a few squares.
steps.explanation: Pieces are stronger in the centre where they control more squares. 'A knight on the rim is dim': on the edge it sees only a few squares.

steps.prompt: Move your knight toward the centre.
steps.explanation: From the centre a knight controls up to 8 squares.
The d5 knight attacks 8 squares; the a1 knight only 2.
A bishop blocked by its own pawns is 'bad'. Open lines make it strong.
